subject: acc-ft
title: ACC.FT.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 113 (ALT(FT)II-7). ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) is the subject; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics), WO-CH (world change) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From TH-CONT-DY: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From WO-CH: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From T-C-IMP: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From PROJ-DY: PER-TRS (perceived transition). From RT-DY: POL-OR (political order). From PER-TRS: REL-TECH (relevant technology).
